title: Iron, Steel & Aluminium — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Iron, Steel & Aluminium Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

gtin.title: GTIN
gtin.description: GTIN-14 product identifier (14-digit Global Trade Item Number).

batchLotNumber.title: Batch / Lot Number
batchLotNumber.description: Production batch or lot number (GS1 AI 10). For steel products this is typically the heat number.

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Individual item serial number for high-value products (coils, plates).

productType.title: Product Type
productType.description: Product category classification within iron, steel, and aluminium.

productName.title: Product Name
productName.description: Commercial product name including grade and delivery condition.

cnCode.title: CN Code
cnCode.description: Combined Nomenclature code (EU customs, 8 digits). Critical for CBAM goods identification and benchmark determination.

steelGradeDesignation.title: Steel Grade / Alloy Designation
steelGradeDesignation.description: Steel grade per EN 10027-1 (symbolic name) and EN 10027-2 (numeric), or aluminium alloy per EN 573/EN 1706.

countryOfManufacture.title: Country of Manufacture
countryOfManufacture.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of production location. Determines CBAM default benchmark values and carbon price.

facilityId.title: Facility ID
facilityId.description: Production facility identifier. For CBAM: installation ID in CBAM registry. Installation-level emissions data is tied to this ID.

primaryMaterialType.title: Primary Material Type
primaryMaterialType.description: Primary material classification. CBAM distinguishes carbon steel, stainless, low-alloy, high-alloy for benchmark determination.

chemicalComposition.title: Chemical Composition
chemicalComposition.description: Elemental composition per EN 10204 mill certificate. Weight percentages for each alloying element.

recycledContentPercentage.title: Recycled Content (Total %)
recycledContentPercentage.description: Total recycled material content by weight. ESPR will set minimum thresholds via delegated act (expected 2027-2028).

recycledContentVerification.title: Recycled Content Verification
recycledContentVerification.description: Method used to verify recycled content claims.

coatings.title: Coatings
coatings.description: Surface coatings applied to the product (galvanizing, painting, etc.).

yieldStrengthMpa.title: Yield Strength (MPa)
yieldStrengthMpa.description: Minimum yield strength ReH in megapascals, from EN 10204 mill certificate.

elongationPct.title: Elongation (%)
elongationPct.description: Elongation at break A5 (%) from tensile test.

impactEnergy.title: Impact Energy (Charpy)
impactEnergy.description: Charpy V-notch impact test results per ISO 148-1.

hardness.title: Hardness
hardness.description: Hardness test result (Brinell, Rockwell, or Vickers).

productionRoute.title: Production Route
productionRoute.description: Primary steelmaking or aluminium smelting route. Determines CBAM default benchmark.

productionDate.title: Production Date
productionDate.description: Date of manufacture or final processing.

heatNumber.title: Heat Number
heatNumber.description: Steel heat/melt number for traceability to a specific melt.

heatTreatment.title: Heat Treatment
heatTreatment.description: Delivery condition / heat treatment applied to the steel product.

electricityGridIntensity.title: Electricity Grid Carbon Intensity
electricityGridIntensity.description: Grid emission factor in gCO2/kWh. Critical for aluminium indirect emissions calculation under CBAM.

renewableSharePct.title: Renewable Energy Share (%)
renewableSharePct.description: Share of renewable electricity used in production.

electricityConsumedKwhPerT.title: Electricity Consumed (kWh/t)
electricityConsumedKwhPerT.description: Electricity consumption per tonne of product. Especially critical for EAF and aluminium smelting.

rawMaterialOrigin.title: Raw Material Origin
rawMaterialOrigin.description: Origin of raw materials (iron ore, bauxite, scrap, etc.) for supply chain traceability.

reductionAgent.title: Reduction Agent
reductionAgent.description: Primary reductant used in iron/aluminium reduction. Determines direct process emissions.

totalCarbonFootprint.title: Total Carbon Footprint
totalCarbonFootprint.description: Product carbon footprint per ISO 14067 / EU PEF. Cradle-to-gate value in kgCO2e/kg. Overlaps with CBAM embedded emissions.

scope1DirectEmissions.title: Scope 1 Direct Emissions
scope1DirectEmissions.description: Direct emissions from the production installation. THE primary CBAM field for iron/steel.

scope2IndirectEmissions.title: Scope 2 Indirect Emissions
scope2IndirectEmissions.description: Indirect emissions from purchased electricity/heat. Counted in CBAM for aluminium only; required in DPP for all.

scope3UpstreamEmissions.title: Scope 3 Upstream Emissions
scope3UpstreamEmissions.description: Upstream value chain emissions (raw materials, transport). CBAM counts precursor emissions only.

precursorEmissions.title: Precursor Emissions
precursorEmissions.description: Emissions from CBAM precursor inputs (e.g., pig iron, DRI, sinter, pellets). Summed into total CBAM embedded emissions.

calculationMethodology.title: Calculation Methodology
calculationMethodology.description: Standard or methodology used for carbon footprint calculation.

thirdPartyVerification.title: Third-Party Verification
thirdPartyVerification.description: Third-party verification of carbon footprint data. Mandatory for CBAM from 2026 definitive phase.

carbonIntensityClass.title: Carbon Intensity Class
carbonIntensityClass.description: Performance class (A-G) when established by delegated act.

euEtsBenchmarkProduct.title: EU ETS Benchmark Product
euEtsBenchmarkProduct.description: EU ETS product benchmark reference for EU producers.

dataQuality.title: Data Quality
dataQuality.description: Quality level of emissions data: actual verified, actual unverified, or default benchmark values.

cbamGoodsType.title: CBAM Goods Type
cbamGoodsType.description: Simple (no CBAM precursors, e.g. pig iron) or Complex (contains CBAM precursors, e.g. steel plate from pig iron).

totalSpecificEmbeddedEmissions.title: Total Specific Embedded Emissions
totalSpecificEmbeddedEmissions.description: Total embedded emissions per tonne for CBAM declaration (direct + precursor for steel; direct + indirect + precursor for aluminium).

carbonPricePaid.title: Carbon Price Paid
carbonPricePaid.description: Carbon price already paid in country of origin. Deducted from CBAM certificates an importer must surrender.

cbamDeclarantEori.title: CBAM Declarant EORI Number
cbamDeclarantEori.description: EU Economic Operators Registration and Identification number of the CBAM declarant (importer).

cbamAccountNumber.title: CBAM Account Number
cbamAccountNumber.description: CBAM account ID in the EU CBAM registry.

svhcPresent.title: Contains SVHC
svhcPresent.description: Whether the product contains Substances of Very High Concern above 0.1% w/w threshold per REACH Article 33.

svhcCandidateListSubstances.title: SVHC List
svhcCandidateListSubstances.description: List of SVHC substances present above 0.1% w/w, with CAS numbers and concentrations.

reachRegistrationNumbers.title: REACH Registration Numbers
reachRegistrationNumbers.description: REACH registration numbers for applicable substances.

restrictedSubstancesCompliance.title: Restricted Substances Compliance
restrictedSubstancesCompliance.description: Compliance with REACH Annex XVII substance restrictions.

gwpTotal.title: GWP Total
gwpTotal.description: Global warming potential total per declared unit (kg CO2 eq.). EN 15804+A2 indicator.

odp.title: Ozone Depletion Potential
odp.description: Ozone depletion potential in kg CFC-11 eq. per declared unit.

ap.title: Acidification Potential
ap.description: Acidification potential in mol H+ eq. per declared unit.

waterUse.title: Water Use
waterUse.description: Water use in m3 world eq. per declared unit.

epdReferenceUri.title: EPD Reference URI
epdReferenceUri.description: URI to the Environmental Product Declaration document.

epdProgramOperator.title: EPD Program Operator
epdProgramOperator.description: Name of the EPD program operator (e.g. IBU, EPD International, BRE).

lifecycleModules.title: Lifecycle Modules
lifecycleModules.description: Covered LCA modules per EN 15804+A2 (e.g. A1-A3, C1-C4, D).

declaredUnit.title: Declared Unit
declaredUnit.description: Declared or functional unit for EPD environmental indicators.

expectedServiceLifeYears.title: Expected Service Life (Years)
expectedServiceLifeYears.description: Expected product service life in years.

recyclabilityPercentage.title: Recyclability (%)
recyclabilityPercentage.description: Percentage of product mass that is recyclable.

endOfLifeInstructions.title: End-of-Life Instructions
endOfLifeInstructions.description: URI to dismantling, recycling, or end-of-life guidance.

ceMarking.title: CE Marking
ceMarking.description: Whether CE marking is applied (required for construction products under CPR).

declarationOfPerformanceUri.title: Declaration of Performance URI
declarationOfPerformanceUri.description: URI to the Declaration of Performance document for construction products.

inspectionCertificateType.title: Inspection Certificate Type
inspectionCertificateType.description: EN 10204 inspection document type: 2.1 (declaration), 2.2 (test report), 3.1 (mill cert by manufacturer QA), 3.2 (mill cert with third-party countersignature).

inspectionCertificateUri.title: Inspection Certificate URI
inspectionCertificateUri.description: URI to the EN 10204 mill certificate PDF or structured data.

responsibleSteelCertification.title: ResponsibleSteel Certification
responsibleSteelCertification.description: ResponsibleSteel site and/or product certification (voluntary, 13 principles, 4 progress levels for decarbonisation).

asiCertification.title: ASI Certification
asiCertification.description: Aluminium Stewardship Initiative certification (Performance Standard + Chain of Custody V2.1).

euEtsInstallationId.title: EU ETS Installation ID
euEtsInstallationId.description: EU ETS installation permit ID. EU ETS installations are exempt from CBAM when selling within the EU.

supplyChainEvents.title: Supply Chain Events
supplyChainEvents.description: Supply chain traceability events (EPCIS 2.0 aligned): mining, smelting, rolling, finishing, shipping, etc.

dataCarrier.title: Data Carrier
dataCarrier.description: Type of data carrier used to link to the DPP (QR, NFC, RFID, DataMatrix).

accessLevel.title: Access Level
accessLevel.description: Default access tier for this DPP: public, restricted (recyclers/processors), or authority-only.

registryEntryUri.title: Registry Entry URI
registryEntryUri.description: URI in the EU DPP central registry (operational from July 2026).

dataFormat.title: Data Format
dataFormat.description: Machine-readable data format per ESPR requirements.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Available languages for this DPP per ESPR Article 8.

ceMarkingStatus.title: CE Marking Status
ceMarkingStatus.description: Whether the product bears CE marking and its validity
